name: Movie Producer Pitch Saga (With No Candy)
source:
In this game, you play as Zachary Goldman, a famous movie producer. You've just been approached by a young man asking you to read his screenplay, and it's your job to crush his dreams by changing things so much that the story is unrecognizable from it's original form!

Contains 10 unique endings, including "true" ending unlocked by finding all the other endings.

[Edited from [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2014/games/movie-producer-pitch-saga-no-candy]Global Game Jam[/url]]
